contract_checked: Fixed71 executors and74 parent actions retained. Only two named held_verified/reconcile steps obtain readiness evidence; exact five parent shared sessions include the three existing phases.

A parent-claim-bound locked readiness stage precedes authoritative full inspection/checkpoint/heads/request.90-second readiness acceptance consumes the existing300-second executor phase budget; preparing/sealing consumes the same budget.

Readiness binds retained successful debug/signal intent/results, prior executor natural exit, stable immutable heads, raw query links, exact ready holder/guard/old absence and unchanged other role. Child exact head/revalidation semantics remain unchanged.

Sibling native attempt root exists before initial identity queries and blocks blind attempt reuse. Parent plus71 possible executor callers use bounded append-only chains with direct Popen creation and natural return or explicit unresolved state; no timeout kill or retry.

Production sink design explicitly separates query-only preverified attempts from fixed transaction mutations; actual bootstrap/bootout/debug paths require verified recorder plus flags/session/role/source gates. Defaults do not silently construct native authority.
No prior failed fixture or successful abort acceptance transfers. Actual new implementation/source closure/guarded tests/final enabled release/owned fixture/raw independent acceptance remain pending.
implementation_constraints: Nonzero natural query returns can prove absence only under their exact per-command status/output rules. Do not implement the interface narrative as a universal returncode-zero requirement: ps/lsof and missing-service launchctl cases intentionally accept specific nonzero returns. Mutation success still requires its precise successful result and effect proof.

Parent native commands must be tied to initial/setup/readiness/finalize ownership/time intervals, and query links must resolve to that exact command and phase. A matching allowed argv elsewhere in the run cannot substitute.

Before polling, hydrate only exact validated retained signal/debug reservations; fresh attach initially lacks signalled state. An early full authoritative inspection must not become a hidden prerequisite or authority.

Consumers must enforce all record counts/order/finite times, native child natural-reap evidence and no unresolved attempts, exact five sessions, full inventory bounds and after-parent absence. Claimed boolean readiness or elapsed metadata alone is insufficient.

Production incomplete mutation evidence remains a separate blocker; a later owned-holder appearance cannot erase an unresolved native child or authorize control replay. Review the upcoming recorder/adoption wiring, not just this design.
